commits.subject: Use typed context window IDs throughout thread persistence (#60757)
commits.reason: Carry ContextWindowId through checkpoints, rollout recording and thread creation, retaining UUIDv7/legacy numeric handling. Adapt ALab-owned memory/ephemeral records to the typed IDs instead of converting generated identities to strings.

commits.subject: Fix Unicode caseless matching in thread search (#60759)
commits.reason: Use Unicode caseless folding with source-character boundaries for literal search so expansions and Greek sigma variants highlight original UTF-16 ranges correctly. Keep the existing nonempty query/page-size validation and pagination.
evidence: Read LiteralMatcher folding and boundary advancement plus the actual paginated app-server search regression covering emoji, sigma variants, sharp-s expansion and newer Unicode mapping. Confirmed the public search entry rejects empty/whitespace-only needles before matching.
commits.revisit: Run the changed searchOccurrences integration test and relevant thread-store search tests on the exact integrated source.

commits.subject: Hand off approved plans through attachments in fresh sessions (#60763)
commits.reason: Prepare approved plans against the new thread executor before replacing the current UI. Prefer an app-server attachment verified byte-for-byte under executor permissions; bounded complete fallback becomes untrusted tool output, and oversized/unavailable fallback preserves the original session. Retain native permission-root switch holds and explicit startup configuration precedence. Bind ALab continuation classification to the exact already-prepared thread and its first accepted approved prompt, rather than a next-root marker sent after thread creation.
evidence: Reviewed experimental RPC routing, direct-input gate, absolute attachment-path parsing, active-turn rejection, executor filesystem metadata/content checks and five-second timeout. Read fallback byte/context/item bounds and UTF-8 chunking, TUI prepare/adopt/error unsubscribe flow, shared goal attachment helpers and plan-mode event routing. The new attachment path is local app-server storage, not an external publication.
Reapplied existing alab/removed-paths for Bazel-only changes. The Cargo graph does not read these deleted build descriptions; upstream snapshot fixture data remains available to Cargo tests.

Audited Shared::continue_work/take_continuation and the actual Autopilot ThreadLifecycleContributor: upstream now starts the target before preparation returns, so the old marker would miss it and leak to a subsequent root. The owned target/prompt fact is consumed only by the current runtime at native UserMessage completion; it neither grants action nor stamps human input. Legacy pre-creation provider continuations retain their existing path.
commits.revisit: Run actual large-plan attachment, write/read failure fallback and oversized fallback TUI cases, native startup/default/draft/goal/composer contracts, and retained session handoff under the exact new source. Require actual native opening tests for exact target/prompt acceptance, unrelated roots, edited first input and no work before acceptance, alongside successful/failing TUI preparation cases.

commits.subject: Derive history and notes tool schemas from typed requests (#60770)
commits.reason: Generate history/notes tool contracts from typed Rust requests while preserving published nullability, numeric bounds, enum values, encrypted annotations and note-write required ordering. evidence: Read typed request definitions, positive-count/schema helpers and derive mapping for all nine actions. The tool builder still uses strict=false and the original JSON backend path is unchanged; existing bundled snapshot captures the wire contract.
commits.revisit: Run unchanged bundled-tool snapshot and all history/notes schema/catalog/backend cases, including optional/null and encrypted properties.

commits.subject: Preserve model-facing ID allocations in saved history (#60771)
commits.reason: Preserve allocation provenance separately from string-only provider IDs in all ALab memory history paths. Keep upstream equality/hash/order based on rendered IDs and legacy string reading; never rely on equality alone to prove allocation retention or send private sidecars to provider requests.
evidence: Read ResponseItemId::Generated/ResponseItemIdAllocation, OptionalWireItemId on ResponseItem and InterAgentCommunication, rollout ItemPayload and Guardian checkpoint sidecars, structured window validation and string request metadata. Audited ALab MemoryItem and MemoryRecord::InterAgentCommunication: both need explicit allocation retention because provider serialization drops it and new equality ignores it.
commits.revisit: Implement owned typed sidecars and direct allocation assertions for ordinary/review/compacted/raw/private/inter-agent history, actual capture/decode/install, plus upstream legacy/wire/invalid-window tests before qualification.

commits.subject: Resolve saved Daybreak choices for each subagent turn (#60773)
commits.reason: Retain upstream default-false DaybreakProgramPropagation and its explicit activation boundary while adopting per-turn child-model selection. Keep implicit choices bound to their admitted AuthOwner, preserve explicit child/parent overrides and next-turn model changes, and retain rejected input without issuing unauthorized model requests.
evidence: Read SavedProgramResolution and HelperTurnAdmission, child source distinction and adaptation, both spawn entry points, regular-task rejection/input persistence and live model-change rejection. Unlike preceding d9, saved intent now actually selects requests. Existing ALab cold resumes intentionally create InitialHistory::Resumed; old AuthOwner/enrollment must not be serialized into fresh runtime authority.

The new real helper/tree fixture exercises first-party compressed requests. The ALab-owned test-support decoder handles standard zstd frames independently with bounded output/window memory; it does not disable production compression. Native metadata resolution changes only the ALab crate dependency edge and retains every upstream registry/git identity, with the unchanged source-recorded allocative override.
commits.revisit: Run native helper model-specific/compaction/WebSocket/account-change/rejected-input-resume tests for both spawn versions and explicit overrides; audit restored/pending ALab child options under fresh authority and rerun account, model-discovery and policy contracts without enabling the feature by default. Complete same-account implicit, cross-account refusal/input retention and explicit-override native tree scenarios against actual compressed requests; malformed/oversized fixture payloads must refuse.
